bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-case classification accuracy and performance gaps across gender subgroups (e.g., male/female) using the CelebA dataset for face attribute classification and the CivilComments dataset for online toxicity prediction.
Measuring worst-case classification accuracy and fairness across various demographic identities, including racial groups (e.g., White), using the CivilComments dataset for toxicity detection.

Evaluating worst-case classification accuracy across satellite images from five different geographical regions (Africa, the Americas, Oceania, Asia, and Europe) using the FMoW dataset to detect regional disparities.

Measuring the worst-case subpopulation accuracy to test model reliance on spurious environmental cues rather than robust features (e.g., classifying waterbirds vs. landbirds against mismatched background contexts) using the Waterbirds dataset.
